source: apps/asemanctl/src/cli dispatch plus this compatibility contract

exit_codes.0: command completed or help was displayed
exit_codes.1: usage error or command execution failed
exit_codes.2: typed process configuration was invalid before command dispatch

output_modes.human: stable for operator meaning, not for field parsing
output_modes.json_optional: a documented --json flag emits one JSON document

json_error.note: reserved target envelope; commands not marked json/json_optional must not be parsed as structured output

compatibility.reason: ADR 0004 window closed 2026-09-28: the Docker-era and local legacy lifecycle commands and the casparctl alias are deleted; start/stop/status act on the bootstrapped compact deployment
compatibility.change_rule: removing or renaming a command, changing an exit meaning, or changing a structured schema requires a versioned contract and compatibility evidence
